name: PlaYce Warda (Carrefour)
description: A modern and spacious commercial center located in the heart of Yaoundé, featuring a Carrefour hypermarket, international fashion brands, beauty shops, and a vibrant food court.
bonASavoir: Entry is free, but security checks at the entrance are mandatory. Peak hours occur on Saturday afternoons, leading to heavy parking congestion. Expect higher prices on imported goods.
